onboarding.title: Welcome to MicroRecouv
onboarding.subtitle: Three steps to get started — under a minute.
onboarding.palette_hint: Tip: Ctrl+K opens the navigation palette.
onboarding.dir_1: Read the 3 dashboard questions (PAR, alerts, collections).
onboarding.dir_2: Handle an ML alert if one is open.
onboarding.dir_3: Open KPIs if an indicator is 0 — the pipeline may not have run.
onboarding.chef_1: Approve or reject files due today.
onboarding.chef_2: Check team performance (90 days) if an agent is down.
onboarding.chef_3: Reassign a file if an agent is away.
onboarding.rr_1: Open today’s queue: most overdue claims.
onboarding.rr_2: Log an action (type is prefilled from the phase).
onboarding.rr_3: Search a client by name, loan ID or phone.
onboarding.agent_2: Find a client by name or phone.
onboarding.agent_3: Watch your clients’ alerts at the bottom of Home.
onboarding.ac_1: Create a file in 4 steps — a draft is saved.
onboarding.ac_2: Search the client by name, code or phone.
onboarding.ac_3: Submit: the branch manager will see it for approval.
onboarding.caisse_1: Collection: confirm the amount before saving.
onboarding.caisse_2: Disbursement: find the file, then confirm.
onboarding.caisse_3: A receipt shows after success — avoid double-clicks.
onboarding.anl_1: Check the pipeline: a failed DAG shows the cause and logs.
onboarding.anl_2: Scoring: filter weak scores, then act.
onboarding.anl_3: Drift: if PSI exceeds the threshold, plan a retrain.
onboarding.dsi_1: The health banner flags system and GDPR alerts.
onboarding.dsi_2: Settings: logo stored on the server (no external cloud).
onboarding.dsi_3: Audit trail for every sensitive action.
onboarding.sup_1: Tickets past SLA are marked in red.
onboarding.sup_2: Take ownership, then reply — the user is notified.
